{{short description|Austrian botanist}}
'''Wilfried Morawetz''' (born 17 November 1951 in [[Leoben]], [[Austria]] - died 13 March 2007 in [[Leipzig]], [[Germany]])<ref name="Sächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Leipzig - 12 February 1999 - Wilfried Morawetz, Prof. Dr. phil.">{{cite web |title=Wilfried Morawetz, Prof. Dr. phil. |url=https://www.saw-leipzig.de/de/mitglieder/morawetzw |website=[[Sächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Leipzig]] |access-date=31 December 2020 |date=12 February 1999}}</ref> was an [[Austrians|Austrian]] [[botanist]].<ref name="Harvard University Herbaria & Libraries - Index of Botanists - Morawetz, Wilfried">{{cite web |title=Harvard University Herbaria & Libraries - Index of Botanists - Morawetz, Wilfried |url=https://kiki.huh.harvard.edu/databases/botanist_search.php?mode=details&id=14689 |website=[[Harvard University Herbaria]] |publisher=[[Harvard University]] |accessdate=31 December 2020}}</ref> He made his doctorate 1980 at the [[University of Vienna]].
